title: httptheus — Outbound HTTP
description: Outbound HTTP traffic recorded by boring-o11y/httptheus.

panels.title: Requests/sec
panels.description: Transfers per second. A redirect hop and a retry are each their own transfer.

panels.title: Failure rate
panels.description: 4xx, 5xx and transfers that never got a response, over all transfers.

panels.title: Latency p$quantile
panels.description: +Inf here means everything landed past the last bucket. Extend httptheus.buckets.

panels.title: Transport errors/sec
panels.description: Transfers that never received a response: timeouts, DNS, refused connections, TLS.

panels.title: Traffic by host
panels.description: Every host the application called in the selected range. The percentile column follows the Quantile picker above.

value.title: Filter the dashboard to this host

targets.expr: sum by (host) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint", status_class=~"4xx|5xx|error"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (host) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])), 1e-9)

sum by (host) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (host) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])), 1e-9)
histogram_quantile($quantile, sum by (host, le) (rate(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile($quantile, sum by (host, le) (rate(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Traffic by endpoint
panels.description: Paths are normalised: identifier-shaped segments become :id, and a trailing * means the label is a prefix. The percentile column follows the Quantile picker above.

targets.expr: sum by (host, endpoint) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))
sum by (host, endpoint) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint", status_class=~"4xx|5xx|error"}[$__range]))

sum by (host, endpoint) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint", status_class=~"4xx|5xx|error"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (host, endpoint) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])), 1e-9)

sum by (host, endpoint) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (host, endpoint) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])), 1e-9)
histogram_quantile($quantile, sum by (host, endpoint, le) (rate(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile($quantile, sum by (endpoint, le) (rate(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: The full bucket distribution, so a bimodal response time is visible where a percentile would average it away.

panels.title: Transport errors/sec by reason
panels.description: Only transfers that never got a response reach this counter. HTTP error statuses are in the panel to the left.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (host, endpoint, status_class) (increase(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint", status_class=~"4xx|5xx|error"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Failure ratio by host
panels.description: clamp_min keeps an idle host at zero rather than leaving a gap, so this is safe to alert on.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint", status_class=~"4xx|5xx|error"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (host) (rate(httptheus_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Off by default (httptheus.metrics.in_flight). The gauge increments on entry and decrements on exit, so a fatal error between the two leaks a permanent +1 that only `php artisan httptheus:wipe` will clear.

panels.title: Distinct endpoint labels
panels.description: Each distinct endpoint label is 16 series in the histogram alone. If this climbs, set httptheus.endpoints.patterns or turn the endpoint label off — the Prometheus client never expires a label combination, so the series survive in storage until they are wiped.

options.content:
The storage adapter has to outlive the request that wrote to it.

| Runtime | Use |
|---|---|
| PHP-FPM | `apcu` — per host, survives between requests |
| Queue workers | `redis` — APCu does not cross process boundaries |
| Octane / single process | `memory` is fine |

`memory` under PHP-FPM returns an **empty scrape every time**: the request that served it never saw the increments.

Check the resolved driver with `php artisan about`.

With `redis`, every instance reports the **same** totals — scrape exactly one target.
